calculation.description: Ranks assets by trailing 20-session log momentum normalized by trailing 60-session downside deviation. The one-session lag ensures only completed-day information is used. Positive values indicate momentum achieved with comparatively lower downside risk.

admission_gates.tested_horizon_note: The binding IC/ICIR gates were applied to the validated 10-session forward horizon; daily horizon IC was -0.006394 and did not pass.

validation.regime_notes: 10-session IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.060981), 2023-2025 (0.014945), and 2028-2030 (0.025885), but negative in 2026-2027 (-0.008886). Interpret uncertainty conservatively for the 15-asset cross-section.
validation.deprecation_reason: Failed binding daily paper gate: daily IC=-0.006394 and annualized daily ICIR=-0.3181; positive 10-day result is not admissible under the benchmark daily gate.

notes: Validated on all 15 tradable benchmark instruments with at least 8 names per date; no observation-only macro series were traded. Longer-horizon result is exploratory and should receive modest ensemble weight until correlation and live drift are assessed.
